title: Tha Sakina Ka Ye Nouha Mere Baba Baba
body:
Tha Sakina Ka Ye Nouha Mere Baba Baba
Sune Jungle Me Hai Beti Teri Tanha Baba
Bhai Akbar Bhi Gaye Aun-o-Mohammed Bhi Gaye
Koi Bhi Lout Ke Maqtal Se Na Aaya Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Nekh Lene Ki Tamanna LIye Bhaiti hi Rahi
Mera Bhai Mera Qasim Bhi Na Aaya Baba
Mera Saqha Wo Mera Chahane Wala Ammu
Naher Par Sogaya Bedasth Wo Pyasa Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Dasth Me So-Gaye Sab Naaz Utane Wale
Kya Kare Kis Ko Pukaregi Sakina Baba
Zaqmi Ruksar Hai Aur Qakh Pa Bechain Ho Me
Neend Kaise Hai Kaha Ap Ka Seena Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Sabr Ka Wada Hai Aur Sabr Karti Ho Magar
Kyon Lagata Hai Tamache Mujhe Aada Baba
Kha Rahi Hu Mai Tamache Mere Ghouhar Bhi Chine
Kaan zaqmi Huwe Aur Jal-Gaya Kurta Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Maa Behene Rasan Bastha Hai Bhai Hai Aseer
Kis-Ko Ab Koun De Aise Me Dilasa Baba
Dekho Ruksar Hai Sujhe Huwe Gardan Zaqmi
Kya Yatimo Ko Yon Milta Hai Pursa Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahti Thi Roke Sakina Yahi Maqtal Me Rasheed
Baba marjayege Ab Teri Sakina Baba
